verdict.rationale: The manual documents conversion between Markdown flavors, HTML, LaTeX and Word docx, using -f/-t or extension guessing, with a listable set of formats. Hands-on reports corroborate Markdown→Word and Word→Markdown use, including correct mapping of headers to Word styles. Fidelity caveats are minor: lossy Markdown round-trips and an older-version report of mangled documents. Missing for 10: any evidence of EPUB as an input or output format, and evidence of lossless round-trip fidelity.
